newsitem.title: USA: US spot diesel diffs weaken late, NYMEX collapses.
newsitem.headline: US spot diesel diffs weaken late, NYMEX collapses.

text.p: U.S. spot product differentials showed little movement by late Wednesday, though outright prices slid lower tracking the NYMEX selloff.
NYMEX April heating oil and gasoline, which both reach expiration Monday, fell sharply during late session trading. April heating oil fell 1.40 cents while April gasoline shed 1.70 cents.
Nearby low sulphur diesel diffs did see some weakness, traders said, as buyers for nearby barrels backed off.
New York Harbor (NYH) prompt low sulphur diesel was talked between 2.50 and 2.65 cents over the NYMEX, down about 0.50 cent on the day.
U.S. Gulf (USG) low sulphur diesel for the back ninth cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline slipped to about 0.50 cent under the print, down from about even on Tuesday.
Howvever, tenth cycle low sulphur material firmed to about 0.35 cent over, a gain of about 0.25 cent.
NYH conventional unleaded M4 gasoline firmed to between 5.00 to 5.25 cents under the screen, although market watchers said trade in that product remained very thin.
NYH unleaded M2 "summer grade" gasoline remained steady at about 2.50 cents under the screen.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
